definitions.attribution: manually reviewed evidence receipt is required; outcome differences alone do not establish an output-related cause
definitions.limits: six historical tasks, dependent repositories, two repetitions; no significance, general superiority, market demand or causal claim
definitions.paired_corpus: complete valid raw/Mini/RTK task-repetition triples, without selecting successful repairs
definitions.primary_tokens: CLI aggregate input_tokens + output_tokens, once per session; cached input included and reasoning is not added again
definitions.reference_tokens: not measured by this stdlib analyzer; visible_response_bytes counts serialized solver-visible tool responses
definitions.repeated_test: extra occurrences of identical literal test argv and cwd within a trial
definitions.test_command: cargo test/nextest, npm test/t or run script beginning test, node --test
definitions.uncached_proxy: input_tokens - cached_input_tokens + output_tokens, unavailable if cached input was not reported; not a monetary cost
